reason: Read all prose, cross-platform mapping, Mermaid and checklist. This is WCAG/ARIA/platform UI implementation guidance, without a distinct prompt, context or agent-control mechanism; language-specific UI API examples excluded as domain implementation. Standards numbers and success-criterion labels are frozen source claims, not verified current compliance advice.

Read all architecture prose, module trees, dependency graph, anti-patterns and pointers. Kotlin domain/data/presentation, Room/Ktor/DI and Gradle examples are application architecture rather than a distinct agent-instruction method; programming examples excluded as domain implementation.

Read all REST naming, status, response-schema, pagination, filtering, authentication, rate-limit, versioning and release-checklist prose and plaintext/JSON examples. This is domain API-contract guidance; TypeScript/Python/Go implementations excluded. No distinct prompt/context mechanism; sample thresholds, six-month deprecation and framework APIs are not universal or current guarantees.

Translation omits canonical buyer/seller/network route table, current-source checks and explicit confirmation boundary. Checking remaining budget before a later paid call does not establish atomic reservation, concurrent-session enforcement or independent policy verification; no-custodial-risk wording is unproven. No payment actions executed.

Semantically equivalent mechanism with localized prose; grep/file presence supplies matching evidence but does not prove runtime activation. Library retention differs from deletion; no variant candidate.

Inspect current in-repo exemplars before external docs, preserve registration/config/auth/error/test conventions and limit needed integration surface. Equivalent source-pattern mechanism; two-exemplar count is a heuristic and style resemblance alone is not behavioral correctness.

Fully read translated/canonical ADR template, decision triggers, explicit draft approval, numbered index, alternatives/consequences and proposed/accepted/deprecated/superseded lifecycle. Mechanism equivalent; historical decisions require date labeling and supersession links. Source approval instructions are research evidence, not invoked in this audit; concurrent number allocation is not solved by scanning and incrementing.

Fully read translated/canonical prose, command workflow and all173 identical programming-code lines. Reproduce known bug with observable contract assertions before self-review. Sample partner-name test is vacuous on empty data; named sandbox/production parity test runs only forced sandbox path, so cannot prove both paths equivalent. SELECT-star example is not least-data proof. Source #1/3-of4/<1s/cannot-recur claims are unverified; blanket never-test-unfailed-code advice is not a general testing boundary.
